caption:
Hybi's Weekly Recap for Feb 1–6.

Court sport players can start with two Pilates sessions a week in pre-season, building single-leg control before speed. Plan one or two lighter or rest days a week, and aim for 7–9 hours' sleep. Mild discomfort during exercise that settles by the next morning is usually acceptable. Painless knee clicking is very common, and sit-to-stands and step-ups often help knees feel more confident.

Scroll back through this week's posts for the full comics. Sharp pain in one spot or a knee that locks is worth an assessment. Book online via the link in bio
